models_evaluated: AI-DSS integrating PI-RADS, automated PSAd, and deep-learning imaging risk score

links.outcome: AI-DSS performance validated across multiple centres and scanners
links.effect: Independent validation cohort of 252 men from six UK centres (multiscanner); AI-DSS at 31% CDR avoided 28 biopsies while missing one ≥GG2 cancer.
links.quote: An AI-DSS integrating PI-RADS scores, automated prostate-specific antigen density (PSAd), and deep-learning imaging risk scores was developed on 770 cases and validated on an independent cohort of 252 men from six UK centres.

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an AI decision support system against historical clinical biopsy decisions across multiple centers to assess biopsy avoidance and diagnostic yield.
